title: Letting Go of Faith, Fear & Control | X-Pastor Call-In Show LIVE

top_liked.author: @Nikea_Aesha
top_liked.text: I’m in DC! I left religion a decade ago. I was a member of a high-control religion where we called the bishop “Daddy.” I won’t name it here, but you may know it (they’re known for their unique brass band music and food). Anyway, since leaving, I’ve gotten a Master’s degree,…

top_liked.text: BEAUTIFUL ! Black men  waking up and getting up, this is what we need as a community.  Life is hard , for most, period.

top_liked.author: @m4yh3mcarter
top_liked.text: As a pastor’s kid and only child, I grew up thinking I had to be perfect—obedient, selfless, and definitely not queer. I spent years hating myself, thinking I was a disappointment to God. That Anakin line, “I want more… and I know I shouldn’t,” always hit me hard. That was me…
